_meta.purpose: validation fixture for Conestruct shoulder closure outputs against CDOT typical applications
_meta.structural_relationship_to_cases_26_27: Case 11 is the general/no-specific-speed shoulder work on freeway/expressway. Cases 26 and 27 are the 65 mph and 75 mph speed-specific variants. Speed limit signs in Case 11 show 'XX' placeholders; signs marked with diamond (♦) are mandatory only when work zone speed is reduced.

legend_symbols_extension.diamond_filled: these devices are not optional if the posted speed limit in the work zone is reduced (new symbol introduced in Case 11; not present in Case 26/27 legend)

case_11.title: Shoulder Work - Freeway/Expressway (general)

scenario.posted_speed_work_zone_mph: XX (placeholder; signs only required when speed reduced)

case_11.trigger_condition: none (Case 11 is the general case; no within-N-ft hazard trigger)

taper.notes: Case 11 uses speed-generic L formula. Actual length depends on S (speed) and W (shoulder width).

buffer_space.interpretation: Case 11 does not lock a specific buffer minimum (unlike Cases 26/27 which post 570'/650' MIN). Conestruct should compute buffer per MUTCD Table 6C-2 or CDOT supplement based on the actual posted speed.

work_zone.interpretation: Work zone shown with L distance both before and after (illustrative). Temporary white edge line callout marks the inboard edge of the closure.

lane_width_minimum.interpretation: Minimum width of remaining travel lane through the work zone (federal MUTCD common minimum). Conestruct should validate that lane_width input meets this minimum on freeway scenarios.

temporary_edge_line.interpretation: New temporary edge line inboard of the work zone delineates the reduced lane width

channelizing_devices.additional_callout: OPTIONAL FOR PAVING OPERATIONS (referring to mobile attenuator)
channelizing_devices.actual_taper_device_count_rule: depends on actual taper length (1/3 L) and §6C.09 max spacing (≤ S ft in taper)
channelizing_devices.diagram_work_zone_protection: concrete barrier (temporary) with lights along the outside of the work zone lane

advance_warning_sequence.distance_note: 1700 ft is min; the segment can be longer per diagram zigzag-break (≈) indicator. Total span from leftmost stack to first WORK ZONE assembly = 2200 ft (1700 + 500).
Distance from G20-5P/R2-1(XX) to G20-5P/R2-6P is labeled VAR (variable, per engineer direction)

advance_warning_sequence.frequency_note: TO BE PROVIDED EVERY 2640' OR THE SPACING OF THE SIGNS MAY BE CHANGED AS DIRECTED BY THE ENGINEER BETWEEN R2-10 AND R2-11 SIGNS
advance_warning_sequence.distance_to_next: 1000 ft minus the VAR distance from position 3
advance_warning_sequence.distance_note: Total span from first WORK ZONE assembly (position 3) to first W21-5aR (position 5) = 1000 ft; the VAR portion is taken from the front of this span

plaques.selection_rule: X is contractor-filled based on work zone length

downstream_sequence.label: SPEED LIMIT XX (placeholder)
downstream_sequence.interpretation: Diamond marker indicates this sign is mandatory only when the work zone posted speed is reduced. If no speed reduction, sign is omitted.

case_specific_notes: Case 11 is the general/speed-generic version. Speed-specific variants are Case 26 (65 mph) and Case 27 (75 mph).
Case 11 includes a W5-1 ROAD NARROWS sign that does NOT appear in Cases 26 or 27.
Case 11 uses 1700/500/VAR/1000/500 distances vs Case 26/27's 530/530/260/260/530/530 — Case 11 is more permissive on placement.
Case 11 introduces the diamond (♦) legend symbol for 'mandatory only when work zone speed reduced' — Cases 26/27 always have reduced speed so the diamond isn't needed there.
Case 11 has no 'WITHIN N FT OF TRAVEL WAY' trigger; Cases 26 and 27 do.
Case 11 annotates 11' MIN lane width; Cases 26 and 27 do not.

exact_match_required: all sign codes in advance_warning_sequence and downstream_sequence
presence of W5-1 ROAD NARROWS sign (unique to Case 11 among shoulder typicals)
presence of W16-2a '1500 FT' plaque under first W21-5aR
presence of W7-3a(X) 'NEXT X MILES' plaque under second W21-5aR
annotation_match_recommended: flashing beacon presence on sunburst-marked signs
fines double sign treatment per star marker
optional device handling per triangle marker
diamond marker handling: downstream R2-1 omitted when no speed reduction
informational_only_not_assertions: diagram taper device count (5) — actual count by §6C.09 spacing rules
diagram concrete barrier presence — illustrative only
work zone L labels — illustrative only, actual length is input
phase_2_decisions_required: How does the validation harness handle the 'XX' speed placeholder? Run Case 11 against a specific test speed (e.g., 55 mph) and substitute, or treat as structural template?

When Conestruct emits a plan without speed reduction, does it include or omit the diamond-marked downstream R2-1? This determines whether the diamond annotation becomes an assertion or stays informational.
The leftmost stack uses 'W20-1 OR W21-5' — does Conestruct pick one based on context? Validation needs to know which to expect.

VAR-labeled distances (R2-10 to first WORK ZONE assembly internal split, first WORK ZONE assembly to FINES DOUBLE assembly) need an interpretation rule: does Conestruct pick a specific value or pass through 'VAR'?
